conclusion.en: Yes: grants, temporary bill support, clean-fuel credits and commercial cofunding can change returns. Their ownership, eligibility, timing and expiry matter. No award has been verified for these proposed new investments; the earlier shared stress result is not proof that charging is an unprofitable business.
conclusion.zh: 确实存在能改变回报的建设补助、临时电费支持、清洁燃料积分及商业共同出资；须核实归属、资格、到账与到期。这些拟建投资尚无已核实授奖，旧的共用压力结果不能证明充电业务不赚钱。

title.en: Machias: new capital and electricity support
title.zh: Machias：新一期资本与电费支持

claim.en: Machias is explicitly listed as an eligible town for Phase 12, due April 30,2027. Capital reimbursement is 100% of eligible costs, capped $300 k/port and $600 k/site, net other grants/expected federal credits. Separately metered electricity is reimbursed 100/80/60/40/20% in years 1-5, capped $300 k/site.
claim.zh: Machias明确列入Phase12，2027年4月30日截止。合格资本支出最高报销100%，每端口30万美元、每址60万美元封顶，扣除其他补贴及预计联邦抵免；独立电表电费前五年按100/80/60/40/20%报销，每址累计30万美元封顶。

limitation.en: No award. Host ownership or executed 5-year 24/7 access agreement, surety/LOC and compliant hardware required. Permanent CCS1 and 150 kW/port simultaneous; NACS encouraged. Bid price increases need approval. Greenville is not in eligible town list. Real estate and most operating overhead excluded. OCPP 2.0.1 and OCPI 2.2.1 are required; Tesla compatibility is unverified. Award is limited by the bid and paid eligible cost. Five-year program access is not proof of a lease covering our full investment horizon.
limitation.zh: 尚无授奖。须有产权或签署五年全天开放协议、保函/信用证及合规设备；每端口永久CCS1及同时150kW，鼓励NACS。提价须批准；Greenville不在名单。房地产及大多数运营管理费用不报销。 还须OCPP2.0.1及OCPI2.2.1，未确认Tesla兼容。授奖受投标金额及实际已付合格成本限制，项目五年开放要求不等于已取得覆盖投资期限的租约。

required.en: Confirm the current application route, exact parcel/design, legal applicant, ownership, complete eligible costs, funding reservation or award, stacking and cash timing before recognition. Tax measures also require a complete taxpayer-specific calculation.
required.zh: 计入前核实当前申请路径、准确地块/设计、合法申请方、产权、完整合格成本、资金预留或授奖、叠加规则和到账时点；税务措施另须完整主体税务计算。

title.en: New Mexico: limited DCFC state credit
title.zh: 新墨西哥州直流快充税收抵免

claim.en: Corporate credit can be up to $25,000 or purchase-and-installation cost, whichever is less, for one DCFC per taxpayer per taxable year. Purchase/install window May 15,2024-before Jan 1,2030; apply within one year.
claim.zh: 公司税收抵免上限为2.5万美元或设备购置安装费孰低；每纳税人每税年仅一个直流快充抵免，不能按八个端口倍增。安装窗口为2024年5月15日至2030年1月1日前，须一年内申请。

limitation.en: New≥50 kW equipment, certification, inspection, networking standards and ownership required. Cannot duplicate 2021 sustainable-building credit expenses. Chama has no certificate; refund/tax timing and stacking need taxpayer-level confirmation.
limitation.zh: 需全新≥50kW设备、认证、验收、联网标准及所有权；不可重复享受2021可持续建筑抵免。Chama尚无认证，退款/税务实现时间及叠加须按纳税主体核实。

required.en: Confirm the current application route, exact parcel/design, legal applicant, ownership, complete eligible costs, funding reservation or award, stacking and cash timing before recognition. Tax measures also require a complete taxpayer-specific calculation.
required.zh: 计入前核实当前申请路径、准确地块/设计、合法申请方、产权、完整合格成本、资金预留或授奖、叠加规则和到账时点；税务措施另须完整主体税务计算。

title.en: Arizona: an active new procurement route
title.zh: 亚利桑那州第三期招标

claim.en: ADOT Phase 3 seeks private design/build/operate/maintain proposals at 49 locations; deadline Jan 15,2027,2 pm MST.
claim.zh: 亚利桑那Phase3正在征集49处设计、建设、运营维护方案，截止2027年1月15日MST14点。

limitation.en: Chinle is only a screening lead. Original target-map PDF returned 403; location fit, contract economics and site eligibility remain unverified. Phase 2 awards cannot be assumed available to a new applicant.
limitation.zh: Chinle仅为进一步筛查线索。原始地理范围PDF返回403，尚未核实选址匹配及合同经济条件；不能把Phase2已授资金视为新申请可用。

required.en: Confirm the current application route, exact parcel/design, legal applicant, ownership, complete eligible costs, funding reservation or award, stacking and cash timing before recognition. Tax measures also require a complete taxpayer-specific calculation.
required.zh: 计入前核实当前申请路径、准确地块/设计、合法申请方、产权、完整合格成本、资金预留或授奖、叠加规则和到账时点；税务措施另须完整主体税务计算。

title.en: Utah: alternative delivery route to clarify
title.zh: 犹他州第二期：窗口状态待确认

claim.en: Phase II targets corridors near fiveNational Park areas and public/private partners. Applicant-delivery deadline was Oct 21,2026; page separately lists UDOT delivery applications at each quarter end.
claim.zh: 犹他PhaseII面向五大国家公园周边走廊及公私合作伙伴。申请方交付模式10月21日已截止；页面另列UDOT交付模式每季度末截止。

limitation.en: The same page says NOW CLOSED. Do not present a confirmed open window without clarification. Hanksville area/parcel eligibility and ownership/revenue arrangement were not established; linked GoogleDrive RFA was unreadable.
limitation.zh: 同页又标注已关闭，不能认定当前可申请。Hanksville的区域/地块资格、资产与收益归属尚未落实，所链接RFA未能读取。

required.en: Confirm the current application route, exact parcel/design, legal applicant, ownership, complete eligible costs, funding reservation or award, stacking and cash timing before recognition. Tax measures also require a complete taxpayer-specific calculation.
required.zh: 计入前核实当前申请路径、准确地块/设计、合法申请方、产权、完整合格成本、资金预留或授奖、叠加规则和到账时点；税务措施另须完整主体税务计算。

title.en: NEVI can support privately owned infrastructure and early operations
title.zh: NEVI私人合作及初期运维支持

claim.en: Federal share is 80% of eligible NEVI costs; private/state funds can supply match. States may contract private acquisition, installation and up to 5 years eligible operations/maintenance. Ownership need not revert to the state, subject to contract.
claim.zh: NEVI联邦份额为合格成本80%，私人或州资金可配套；州可委托私人购建并支持最长五年合格运维。按合同资产不必归还州政府。

limitation.en: Not 80% of every budget item and not automaticcash. Requires active state procurement, geography, compliant design, award and reimbursement evidence. Combined eligible federal-highway funding cannot exceed 80%; match and tax/grant interactions must be checked.
limitation.zh: 不是所有预算项自动补80%，更不是已经到账。须满足州招标、地域、设计、授奖与报销条件；合并联邦公路资金仍不能超80%，配套和税收叠加另核。

required.en: Confirm the current application route, exact parcel/design, legal applicant, ownership, complete eligible costs, funding reservation or award, stacking and cash timing before recognition. Tax measures also require a complete taxpayer-specific calculation.
required.zh: 计入前核实当前申请路径、准确地块/设计、合法申请方、产权、完整合格成本、资金预留或授奖、叠加规则和到账时点；税务措施另须完整主体税务计算。

title.en: NEVI headline allocations overstate remaining available money
title.zh: NEVI资金重分配

claim.en: FHWA Notice N4510.913 of March 12,2026 repurposed $503,756,000 of unobligated NEVIstate balances; removed funds are no longer available for NEVI.
claim.zh: FHWA2026年3月12日N4510.913通知重新分配了5.03756亿美元州级未承诺NEVI余额，这部分已不能用于NEVI。

limitation.en: This does not cancel all NEVI or establish each state remaining balance. Use current procurement/award amounts instead of historical 2022-26 allocations.
limitation.zh: 这不等于取消整个NEVI，也不能据此推算各州剩余可申请金额；应采用当前招标和授奖数据，不能用历史五年总额。

required.en: Confirm the current application route, exact parcel/design, legal applicant, ownership, complete eligible costs, funding reservation or award, stacking and cash timing before recognition. Tax measures also require a complete taxpayer-specific calculation.
required.zh: 计入前核实当前申请路径、准确地块/设计、合法申请方、产权、完整合格成本、资金预留或授奖、叠加规则和到账时点；税务措施另须完整主体税务计算。

title.en: CFI: public partner route with private participation
title.zh: CFI公共机构合作路径

claim.en: CFI direct applicants are eligible public/tribal entities. Private companies may contract with grantees; federal share≤80%. Corridor grants can support initial 5-year eligible operations, subject to caps and contract.
claim.zh: CFI直接申请主体为合格公共机构或部落；私人公司可作为合同合作方，联邦份额≤80%，走廊项目可按限额和合同支持最初五年运维。

limitation.en: No presently open applicable NOFO, local partner or candidate award was established. Potential revenue sharing, private match and operating-assistance limits prevent treating this as an unrestricted grant.
limitation.zh: 尚未落实适用的当前窗口、地方合作方或场地授奖；私人配套、可能的分成和运维限额使其不能当作无限制补贴。

required.en: Confirm the current application route, exact parcel/design, legal applicant, ownership, complete eligible costs, funding reservation or award, stacking and cash timing before recognition. Tax measures also require a complete taxpayer-specific calculation.
required.zh: 计入前核实当前申请路径、准确地块/设计、合法申请方、产权、完整合格成本、资金预留或授奖、叠加规则和到账时点；税务措施另须完整主体税务计算。

title.en: 30C is not available to a newly built October 2026 charging asset
title.zh: 30C新投运资格已截止

claim.en: IRS limits relevant 30C business property to in-service dates through June 30,2026; a new October 2026+installation cannot claim it.
claim.zh: IRS规定相关30C商业设施最晚须2026年6月30日投运；2026年10月以后新建投运不能享受。

limitation.en: Historic 6%/30% rates and $100 k/item caps are not new-project funding. Previously credited assets have basis/recapture rules; existing-site history does not qualify a new expansion.
limitation.zh: 历史6%/30%及每项10万美元上限不是新项目资金；已抵免资产有计税基础和追回规则，既有站点历史不自动覆盖新增扩建。

required.en: Confirm the current application route, exact parcel/design, legal applicant, ownership, complete eligible costs, funding reservation or award, stacking and cash timing before recognition. Tax measures also require a complete taxpayer-specific calculation.
required.zh: 计入前核实当前申请路径、准确地块/设计、合法申请方、产权、完整合格成本、资金预留或授奖、叠加规则和到账时点；税务措施另须完整主体税务计算。

title.en: Separately scoped storage may have 48E value
title.zh: 单独储能方案的48E税惠

claim.en: Eligible stationary energy storage may qualify for 48E:6% base, potentially 30% with applicable labor conditions. Post 2025 construction also faces prohibited-foreign-entity/material-assistance restrictions under 2026 guidance.
claim.zh: 合格固定式储能可能适用48E：基础6%，满足适用劳工条件可能30%；2025年后开工还需满足2026指引的受限外国实体/物料支持规则。

limitation.en: Not a charging-station-wide credit. Requires separately costed storage, ownership, sourcing, tax-basis and claim review. Do not add an assumed credit to pre-tax NPV or omit battery incremental cost/replacement. No project claim verified.
limitation.zh: 不是整座充电站统一抵免。需单列储能成本、所有权、供应链、计税基础及申报核验；不能把假设抵免塞入税前NPV或漏算电池新增成本/更换。未落实具体项目抵免。

required.en: Confirm the current application route, exact parcel/design, legal applicant, ownership, complete eligible costs, funding reservation or award, stacking and cash timing before recognition. Tax measures also require a complete taxpayer-specific calculation.
required.zh: 计入前核实当前申请路径、准确地块/设计、合法申请方、产权、完整合格成本、资金预留或授奖、叠加规则和到账时点；税务措施另须完整主体税务计算。

title.en: Tax depreciation changes investor cash timing, not charging margin
title.zh: 加速折旧：税后现金时点

claim.en: IRS Topic 704 confirms 100% special depreciation for qualified property acquired and placed in service after Jan 19,2025.
claim.zh: IRS Topic704确认：2025年1月19日后取得并投运的合格财产可适用100%特别折旧。

limitation.en: Not a 100%cash grant. Asset classification, basis, tax liability/lossrules and later depreciation displacement determine value. Current pre-tax hurdle must remain unchanged; a complete after-tax investor model is separate.
limitation.zh: 不是100%现金补贴。价值取决于资产分类、计税基础、纳税能力、亏损规则及后续折旧减少。现有税前硬门槛不变，完整投资者税后模型应单列。

required.en: Confirm the current application route, exact parcel/design, legal applicant, ownership, complete eligible costs, funding reservation or award, stacking and cash timing before recognition. Tax measures also require a complete taxpayer-specific calculation.
required.zh: 计入前核实当前申请路径、准确地块/设计、合法申请方、产权、完整合格成本、资金预留或授奖、叠加规则和到账时点；税务措施另须完整主体税务计算。

title.en: WA CFS electricity credits
title.zh: 华盛顿州充电电力积分

claim.en: Non-residential equipment owners can register to generate saleable credits for eligible electricity dispensed. New designation contracts from January 1, 2026 must expressly allocate/waive generation rights. This is an additional operating revenue mechanism, not a charger manufacturing credit.
claim.zh: 非住宅充电设备所有人可登记，就符合条件的实际供电产生可出售的积分。2026年1月1日起的新转让合同须明确积分权利分配或放弃。这是额外经营收入机制，不是充电桩制造商的生产补贴。

limitation.en: For Tesla for Business, obtain the equipment ownership, environmental-attribute and revenue-sharing clauses, metered kWh, registered generator and sale/aggregation fees. Do not assign revenue to a landlord merely because its parking lot hosts EVgo/Tesla equipment. Historical market prices are not guaranteed realized proceeds.
limitation.zh: Tesla for Business须取得设备产权、环境权益及收益分配条款、计量电量、登记生成方和销售/聚合费用。仅为EVgo或Tesla提供停车场的地主不能自动取得积分收入；历史价格不是保证收入。

required.en: signed credit ownership/allocation agreement; WFRS/FSE registration; metered eligible kWh; applicable annual CI and EER; sale counterparty/fees
required.zh: 核实电表/纳税主体、设备认可、项目成本基础、可用额度与授奖、权益归属、计量及实际净收入；相同成本与权益不得重复领取。

title.en: WA LMD-FCI unused-capacity credits
title.zh: 华盛顿州快充闲置容量积分

claim.en: Unused DCFC capacity can earn a separate five-year credit stream after approval. Applications are due by December 31, 2029. Equipment permitted before January 1, 2023 or required as SEPA mitigation is excluded. Public access, network reporting and commissioning are required. Regular dispensing credits remain distinct.
claim.zh: 获批后，直流快充未利用容量可产生独立的五年积分收入，申请截止2029年12月31日。2023年1月1日前获准运行或属于SEPA强制缓解措施的设备不适用。须满足公众开放、联网报告及投运要求；实际充电积分另计。

limitation.en: No current candidate approval or equipment permit date is verified. Existing equipment cannot become newly eligible solely because the atlas proposes an investment. Expansion requires approval and does not restart an existing five-year term. Determine registered FSE boundaries, nameplate and effective simultaneous power for the actual cabinet/post design: eight nominal 250 kW posts must not be blindly counted as 2,000 kW of simultaneous supply. If approved eligible aggregate nameplate exceeds 1,500 kW, an exception is required; the August 25 table showed 44 larger-site equipment slots and 44 approved. Do not assume an exception, new credit clock or flat unused-capacity revenue at high utilization. For approvals after November 20, 2025, generation is subject to the rule’s cumulative-value condition: prior-quarter estimated capacity-credit value must be below 1.5 times initial capex excluding on-site generation, less external capital/operating/maintenance funding. The five-year clock begins in the approval quarter, not at commissioning. Agency value uses quarterly average prices and 10% annual discount to approval-year dollars; this is not guaranteed cash.
limitation.zh: 未核实本候选的积分批准或设备许可日期。把既有站点列作投资候选不等于获得新设备资格；扩建须批准且不能重启已有五年期限。须按真实电源柜/充电柱设计核实登记FSE边界、铭牌功率及同时供电能力，不能直接把8个标称250kW柱视为2,000kW同时供电。若经认可的合格铭牌合计超过1,500kW，须特批；8月25日表中大站设备名额44个、已批准44个。不能假设有特批、新计期或高利用率仍获满额闲置容量收入。 2025年11月20日后批准的项目受累计价值条件约束：上一季度累计估算容量积分价值须低于初始资本支出（不含场内发电）的1.5倍，再扣外部资本、运营和维护资助。五年从获批季度开始，不是从投运开始。监管估值按季度均价及10%年折现折至获批年度，不是保证现金。

required.en: Confirm the exact utility/tax account, approved equipment, project cost basis, available reservation, award terms, recipient and payment timing.
required.zh: 核实电表/纳税主体、设备认可、项目成本基础、可用额度与授奖、权益归属、计量及实际净收入；相同成本与权益不得重复领取。

title.en: Oregon Clean Fuels Program electricity credits
title.zh: 俄勒冈州充电电力积分

claim.en: Oregon identifies the non-residential charger owner, or the operator if the owner does not register, as the electricity credit participant. Registration, transaction records and quarterly/annual reports are required. Credits are tradeable emissions reductions, creating possible additional operating revenue.
claim.zh: 俄勒冈将非住宅充电桩所有人、或所有人未登记时的运营人列为积分参与方。须登记、留存交易记录及季度/年度报告；可交易减排积分可形成额外经营收入。

limitation.en: Ownership and allocation are not verified for these candidates. Use the annual lifecycle electricity CI and approved pathway, not the direct-emissions table alone. September 2026 agency-reported price does not reconcile to the transaction rows in the downloaded workbook; preserve this discrepancy and do not present it as independently verified cashflow.
limitation.zh: 这些候选的产权与积分分配未核实。须采用年度全生命周期电力碳强度及批准路径，不能只取直接排放表。下载的2026年9月官方价格汇总与其交易明细无法复算一致；保留差异，不能声称已独立验证收入。

required.en: equipment owner/operator registration and contractual rights; OFRS/FSE registration; metered eligible kWh; current lifecycle CI/EER; realized credit sale price/fees
required.zh: 核实电表/纳税主体、设备认可、项目成本基础、可用额度与授奖、权益归属、计量及实际净收入；相同成本与权益不得重复领取。

title.en: Pacific Power Oregon business DCFC rebate
title.zh: Pacific Power直流快充返利

claim.en: For approved DCFC equipment at or above 150 kW, Pacific Power offers up to 75% of eligible costs capped at $30,000 per port. The ordinary site maximum is $100,000; larger requests require preapproval. Customer/account, invoices, permits, equipment and funding conditions apply.
claim.zh: Pacific Power对经认可的150kW及以上直流快充最高补贴合格成本75%，每接口上限3万美元。常规每址上限10万美元，更高金额须预批；须满足客户、电表、发票、许可、设备及资金条件。

limitation.en: No Tesla entry was found in the September 22, 2026 approved-product list; StarCharge Titan V4 is a different manufacturer. Treat as an alternate-hardware lead until Tesla V4 eligibility is confirmed in writing. Final itemized invoices rather than estimates are required; apply within one year of equipment purchase. Cannot combine with Pacific Power Fleet Make-Ready at the same site. No Medford award verified.
limitation.zh: 2026年9月22日认可设备表未找到Tesla条目；StarCharge Titan V4不是Tesla。取得Tesla V4书面资格确认前仅作为其他设备方案线索。须提供最终分项发票，购买设备一年内申请；同址不能叠加Pacific Power Fleet Make-Ready。未核实Medford获款。

required.en: Confirm the exact utility/tax account, approved equipment, project cost basis, available reservation, award terms, recipient and payment timing.
required.zh: 核实电表/纳税主体、设备认可、项目成本基础、可用额度与授奖、权益归属、计量及实际净收入；相同成本与权益不得重复领取。

title.en: PGE DCFC rebate waitlist
title.zh: PGE直流快充返利候补名单

claim.en: PGE lists up to $55,000 per port and $330,000 per site for equipment in eligible underserved communities. Its current page says funding is exhausted and new reservations/unreserved applications cannot be approved; waitlist only.
claim.zh: PGE公布符合条件的弱势社区设备补贴每接口最高5.5万美元、每址33万美元，但当前页面注明资金已用完，不能批准新预留或无预留申请，只能排候补。

limitation.en: Equipment only: installation, warranties and network fees are excluded. Permits no earlier than January 1, 2026; actual PGE account, mapped area and all equipment requirements need confirmation. City/territory screening is not address eligibility. This is zero available/committed cash for current decisions.
limitation.zh: 仅设备购置；安装、质保和网络费不在范围。许可日期须不早于2026年1月1日，并核实PGE电表、区域图和设备要求。城市/辖区初筛不等于地址合格。当前决策可确认资金为零。

required.en: Confirm the exact utility/tax account, approved equipment, project cost basis, available reservation, award terms, recipient and payment timing.
required.zh: 核实电表/纳税主体、设备认可、项目成本基础、可用额度与授奖、权益归属、计量及实际净收入；相同成本与权益不得重复领取。

title.en: Washington EV Charging Program
title.zh: 华盛顿州充电项目：当前无开放轮次

claim.en: Commerce reports Round 1 and Round 2 awards but no open funding opportunities; future funding is subject to the legislative session beginning January 2027.
claim.zh: 商务厅公布首轮及第二轮拨款，但当前无开放申请；后续资金取决于2027年1月开始的立法会期。

limitation.en: Historical award totals and a nearby funded station do not create an award for a new candidate. Do not insert the program maximum into net capex.
limitation.zh: 历史总拨款或邻近站点获款不等于本候选获款，不能将项目最高额直接抵减成本。

required.en: Confirm the exact utility/tax account, approved equipment, project cost basis, available reservation, award terms, recipient and payment timing.
required.zh: 核实电表/纳税主体、设备认可、项目成本基础、可用额度与授奖、权益归属、计量及实际净收入；相同成本与权益不得重复领取。

title.en: Clark annual DCFC account credit
title.zh: Clark年度快充电表抵扣

claim.en: Clark advertises $1,500 per year per DC fast charger on a dedicated meter under Schedule 134; Schedule 434 does not qualify. This is a bill-credit route requiring account and equipment confirmation.
claim.zh: Clark对独立电表、Schedule 134下的直流快充公布每台每年1,500美元抵扣；Schedule 434不适用，须核实电表及设备。

limitation.en: Do not multiply by connector count without the utility confirming its charger definition. The separate EV-GO up-to-50% project program is restricted to Clark County municipal/local-government and nonprofit entities, not automatically a private WinCo/investor grant.
limitation.zh: 没有供电公司确认“充电设备”定义前，不能直接乘以接口数。另一个EV-GO最高50%项目仅面向Clark县市政/地方政府及非营利机构，不自动适用于私营WinCo/投资者。

required.en: Confirm the exact utility/tax account, approved equipment, project cost basis, available reservation, award terms, recipient and payment timing.
required.zh: 核实电表/纳税主体、设备认可、项目成本基础、可用额度与授奖、权益归属、计量及实际净收入；相同成本与权益不得重复领取。

title.en: WA alternative-fuel infrastructure B&O / PUT tax credit
title.zh: 华盛顿州基础设施B&O/PUT抵免

claim.en: Current law allows up to 50% of qualifying infrastructure, components and installation/construction cost as a B&O or PUT tax credit, excluding property acquisition and site improvement. It is nonrefundable, first-come, capped statewide and may carry only to the following calendar year. DOR October 1, 2026 reported $5,055,084.37 annual and $12,973,918.88 lifetime availability before outstanding applications.
claim.zh: 现行法允许合格基础设施、部件和安装/施工成本最高50%抵扣B&O或PUT税，不含土地购买和场地改良。不可退税、先到先得、受全州额度约束，最多结转至下一历年。DOR截至2026年10月1日公布年度余量5,055,084.37美元、累计余量12,973,918.88美元，未扣待批申请。

limitation.en: DOR describes eligible commercial-vehicle businesses; no candidate-specific taxpayer/infrastructure interpretation, reservation or usable tax liability is verified. Obtain a project eligibility determination and tax-liability schedule before counting. B&O and PUT cannot both claim the same amount. Unused credit beyond the short carry period has no assumed cash value. A 50% headline is not a cash grant. The reported balances cover the combined vehicle/infrastructure program, not a site reservation: $2m annual infrastructure category, $6m combined annual and $32.5m lifetime caps; unused category credits can be reallocated on September 1 under the statute. Confirm category/reallocated availability before applying.
limitation.zh: DOR的资格表述针对商用车业务；未核实本候选纳税主体/设施解释、额度预留或可抵税负。须取得项目资格确认与税负计划后才计入；相同金额不能同时抵B&O和PUT，短期结转后未用额度不得假设有现金价值。50%标题不是现金补助。 上述余额属于车辆及基础设施合并项目，不是场地预留额度：基础设施类别年度200万美元、合并年度600万美元、累计3,250万美元上限；法律允许9月1日重新分配未用类别额度。申请前核实类别/重新分配后的可用额度。

required.en: Confirm the exact utility/tax account, approved equipment, project cost basis, available reservation, award terms, recipient and payment timing.
required.zh: 核实电表/纳税主体、设备认可、项目成本基础、可用额度与授奖、权益归属、计量及实际净收入；相同成本与权益不得重复领取。

title.en: WA EV infrastructure sales/use tax exemption
title.zh: 华盛顿州已到期销售/使用税豁免

claim.en: The EV infrastructure sales/use and associated leasehold exemption expired July 1, 2025. It is not a new-project tax saving for this October 2026 screen.
claim.zh: 电动车基础设施销售/使用税及相关租赁税豁免已于2025年7月1日到期，不能作为本次2026年10月新项目的减税。

limitation.en: Keep applicable sales/use taxes in complete capex unless a different, independently verified exemption applies. Do not reuse stale incentive directories.
limitation.zh: 完整成本应保留适用销售/使用税，除非另有独立核实的豁免；不能沿用过时补贴目录。

required.en: Confirm the exact utility/tax account, approved equipment, project cost basis, available reservation, award terms, recipient and payment timing.
required.zh: 核实电表/纳税主体、设备认可、项目成本基础、可用额度与授奖、权益归属、计量及实际净收入；相同成本与权益不得重复领取。

title.en: Georgia Power Make Ready (carried from round four)
title.zh: Georgia Power接电建设支持（沿用第四轮）

claim.en: The 2026–2028 Make Ready criteria cap normal program investment at $300,000 per project. Public-facing retail is eligible in principle; at least one DC fast charger is required. Georgia Power owns behind-meter infrastructure; the customer may owe costs above the cap. Future-proofing is excluded. Program terms require property authority and acceptance, with separate funding confirmation. The current page schedules funding through December 31, 2028 or budget exhaustion; site assessment and approved design precede equipment orders.
claim.zh: 2026–2028年Make Ready通常每项目上限30万美元，公共零售场地原则上可申请，至少一台DC快充；表后基础设施由Georgia Power持有，超额可由客户承担，未来预埋扩容不予资助。 项目条款要求物业授权及审批，并另行确认资金；现行页面有效期至2028年12月31日或资金用尽，现场评估和批准设计先于设备订购。

limitation.en: Carried forward from the dated prior review. No current site award or enrollment; program caps are not a rebate against every budget item. Verify award scope and any overlapping funding.
limitation.zh: 沿用有日期的此前核查，无本址授奖或加入证明；项目上限不等于所有预算可抵扣，须核实具体范围及重复资助。

required.en: Owner authority, approved equipment/design, accepted application and written funding amount/tariff enrollment.
required.zh: 业主授权、设备/设计获批、申请受理及书面资助金额/费率加入证明。

title.en: Georgia Power CIEV demand adjustment (carried from round four)
title.zh: Georgia Power CIEV需量调整（沿用第四轮）

claim.en: CIEV-1 applies on request to a dedicated EV meter under PL tariffs, excluding RTP. Billing-demand factors are 0.20/0.40/0.60/0.80 for bills 1–12/13–24/25–36/37–48, ending sooner when rolling 12-month load factor reaches 15%.
claim.zh: CIEV-1须申请，适用PL费率下独立EV电表，不适用RTP；第1至4年计费需量系数为0.20/0.40/0.60/0.80，滚动12个月负荷率达到15%则提前结束。

limitation.en: Carried forward from the dated prior review. No current site award or enrollment; program caps are not a rebate against every budget item. Verify award scope and any overlapping funding.
limitation.zh: 沿用有日期的此前核查，无本址授奖或加入证明；项目上限不等于所有预算可抵扣，须核实具体范围及重复资助。

required.en: Owner authority, approved equipment/design, accepted application and written funding amount/tariff enrollment.
required.zh: 业主授权、设备/设计获批、申请受理及书面资助金额/费率加入证明。

title.en: ODOT Round 3 I-5 route (carried from round four)
title.zh: ODOT第三轮I-5路径（沿用第四轮）

claim.en: Round 3 offers $2,333,835 on I-5 for at least four stations. It reimburses up to 80% of eligible cost with at least 20% match. Real-estate purchase, major off-site grid upgrades and most variable operating costs are excluded. The current scope template calls for final design, third-party contracts, signed utility-work agreement, final utility plans and a commissioning report with proof of energization; reimbursement requires actual invoices and payment proof.
claim.zh: 第三轮为I-5至少4站提供2,333,835美元资金，最多报销合格成本80%，需至少20%配套；不含购地、重大场外电网扩容及大部分可变运营费用。 现行范围模板要求最终设计、第三方合同、签署的供电工程协议、最终公用事业图纸，以及含送电证明的调试报告；报销须有实际发票与付款证明。

limitation.en: Carried forward from the dated prior review. No current site award or enrollment; program caps are not a rebate against every budget item. Verify award scope and any overlapping funding.
limitation.zh: 沿用有日期的此前核查，无本址授奖或加入证明；项目上限不等于所有预算可抵扣，须核实具体范围及重复资助。

required.en: Owner authority, approved equipment/design, accepted application and written funding amount/tariff enrollment.
required.zh: 业主授权、设备/设计获批、申请受理及书面资助金额/费率加入证明。

title.en: Tesla-owned charging network
title.zh: Tesla自营充电网络

description.en: Charging receipts accrue to the charging operator; host terms are separately negotiated. Tesla bears project/operating costs under its own scope; public reseller equipment prices do not disclose its internal costs.
description.zh: 充电收入归充电运营主体，地主条款另行协商。 Tesla按自身范围承担建设运营成本，第三方设备售价不披露其内部成本。

limitation.en: Keep the same investment gates, but do not label third-party illustrative P&L as Tesla’s return.
limitation.zh: 保留同样投资门槛，但不得将第三方示例损益当作Tesla回报。

title.en: Third-party ownership / Tesla service
title.zh: 第三方持有／Tesla运营服务

description.en: Owner sets charging prices and receives remittances less contractual fees; other rights require contract confirmation. Owner buys hardware, contracts installation and pays electricity/site costs. Reconcile equipment service, card/internet fees already included.
description.zh: 业主设定充电价并收取扣合同费用后的结算，其他权益须合同确认。 业主购买设备、委托安装并支付电费及场地成本；核对已含设备服务、刷卡及网络费用。

limitation.en: The existing owner cash-flow framework fits this question, but regional stress inputs are not parcel forecasts.
limitation.zh: 现有业主现金流框架适合此问题，但州级压力输入不是逐址预测。

title.en: Property host / landlord
title.zh: 纯场地提供方／地主

description.en: Negotiated rent or evidenced incremental merchant margin; no automatic ownership of charging receipts or credits. Host obligations and parking opportunity cost are contractual; do not impose an entire charger capex by default.
description.zh: 协商租金或经核实的新增商户毛利，不自动拥有充电收入或积分。 地主责任及停车位机会成本由合同确定，不默认承担整站充电资本支出。

limitation.en: Separate host economics cannot rescue the charging investor’s failed hurdle. No host contract obtained.
limitation.zh: 地主单独收益不能替充电投资方通过门槛，目前未取得地主合同。

title.en: WA LMD-FCI unused-capacity credits
title.zh: 华盛顿州快充闲置容量积分

claim.en: Unused DCFC capacity can earn a separate five-year credit stream after approval. Applications are due by December 31, 2029. Equipment permitted before January 1, 2023 or required as SEPA mitigation is excluded. Public access, network reporting and commissioning are required. Regular dispensing credits remain distinct.
claim.zh: 获批后，直流快充未利用容量可产生独立的五年积分收入，申请截止2029年12月31日。2023年1月1日前获准运行或属于SEPA强制缓解措施的设备不适用。须满足公众开放、联网报告及投运要求；实际充电积分另计。

limitation.en: No current candidate approval or equipment permit date is verified. Existing equipment cannot become newly eligible solely because the atlas proposes an investment. Expansion requires approval and does not restart an existing five-year term. Determine registered FSE boundaries, nameplate and effective simultaneous power for the actual cabinet/post design: eight nominal 250 kW posts must not be blindly counted as 2,000 kW of simultaneous supply. If approved eligible aggregate nameplate exceeds 1,500 kW, an exception is required; the August 25 table showed 44 larger-site equipment slots and 44 approved. Do not assume an exception, new credit clock or flat unused-capacity revenue at high utilization. For approvals after November 20, 2025, generation is subject to the rule’s cumulative-value condition: prior-quarter estimated capacity-credit value must be below 1.5 times initial capex excluding on-site generation, less external capital/operating/maintenance funding. The five-year clock begins in the approval quarter, not at commissioning. Agency value uses quarterly average prices and 10% annual discount to approval-year dollars; this is not guaranteed cash.
limitation.zh: 未核实本候选的积分批准或设备许可日期。把既有站点列作投资候选不等于获得新设备资格；扩建须批准且不能重启已有五年期限。须按真实电源柜/充电柱设计核实登记FSE边界、铭牌功率及同时供电能力，不能直接把8个标称250kW柱视为2,000kW同时供电。若经认可的合格铭牌合计超过1,500kW，须特批；8月25日表中大站设备名额44个、已批准44个。不能假设有特批、新计期或高利用率仍获满额闲置容量收入。 2025年11月20日后批准的项目受累计价值条件约束：上一季度累计估算容量积分价值须低于初始资本支出（不含场内发电）的1.5倍，再扣外部资本、运营和维护资助。五年从获批季度开始，不是从投运开始。监管估值按季度均价及10%年折现折至获批年度，不是保证现金。

title.en: WA CFS electricity credits
title.zh: 华盛顿州充电电力积分

claim.en: Non-residential equipment owners can register to generate saleable credits for eligible electricity dispensed. New designation contracts from January 1, 2026 must expressly allocate/waive generation rights. This is an additional operating revenue mechanism, not a charger manufacturing credit.
claim.zh: 非住宅充电设备所有人可登记，就符合条件的实际供电产生可出售的积分。2026年1月1日起的新转让合同须明确积分权利分配或放弃。这是额外经营收入机制，不是充电桩制造商的生产补贴。

limitation.en: For Tesla for Business, obtain the equipment ownership, environmental-attribute and revenue-sharing clauses, metered kWh, registered generator and sale/aggregation fees. Do not assign revenue to a landlord merely because its parking lot hosts EVgo/Tesla equipment. Historical market prices are not guaranteed realized proceeds.
limitation.zh: Tesla for Business须取得设备产权、环境权益及收益分配条款、计量电量、登记生成方和销售/聚合费用。仅为EVgo或Tesla提供停车场的地主不能自动取得积分收入；历史价格不是保证收入。

title.en: Machias: new capital and electricity support
title.zh: Machias：新一期资本与电费支持

claim.en: Machias is explicitly listed as an eligible town for Phase 12, due April 30,2027. Capital reimbursement is 100% of eligible costs, capped $300 k/port and $600 k/site, net other grants/expected federal credits. Separately metered electricity is reimbursed 100/80/60/40/20% in years 1-5, capped $300 k/site.
claim.zh: Machias明确列入Phase12，2027年4月30日截止。合格资本支出最高报销100%，每端口30万美元、每址60万美元封顶，扣除其他补贴及预计联邦抵免；独立电表电费前五年按100/80/60/40/20%报销，每址累计30万美元封顶。

limitation.en: No award. Host ownership or executed 5-year 24/7 access agreement, surety/LOC and compliant hardware required. Permanent CCS1 and 150 kW/port simultaneous; NACS encouraged. Bid price increases need approval. Greenville is not in eligible town list. Real estate and most operating overhead excluded. OCPP 2.0.1 and OCPI 2.2.1 are required; Tesla compatibility is unverified. Award is limited by the bid and paid eligible cost. Five-year program access is not proof of a lease covering our full investment horizon.
limitation.zh: 尚无授奖。须有产权或签署五年全天开放协议、保函/信用证及合规设备；每端口永久CCS1及同时150kW，鼓励NACS。提价须批准；Greenville不在名单。房地产及大多数运营管理费用不报销。 还须OCPP2.0.1及OCPI2.2.1，未确认Tesla兼容。授奖受投标金额及实际已付合格成本限制，项目五年开放要求不等于已取得覆盖投资期限的租约。

title.en: Network utilization is not a local forecast
title.zh: 网络利用量不是本址预测

claim.en: Tesla reports more than 10 U.S. sessions per stall per day. Our 2/4/8 cases are therefore stress assumptions, not a Tesla population forecast.
claim.zh: Tesla自述美国平均每枪每天超过10次；现有2/4/8次应视为压力假设，不能当作Tesla总体预测。

limitation.en: No sample period, distribution or candidate capture is disclosed. Do not assign the network mean to a new site.
limitation.zh: 未披露样本期间、分布或候选址可获取需求，不能直接套用网络均值。

title.en: Separate owner and operator responsibilities
title.zh: 区分业主与运营商责任

claim.en: Tesla assigns installation and ordinary site cleanup to the owner; equipment service, software and network operations are Tesla responsibilities.
claim.zh: Tesla将安装及普通场地清洁分配给业主，设备服务、软件及网络运营由Tesla负责。

limitation.en: Specific pricing, exclusions, guarantees and remedies require the executed agreement. The generic model cannot establish Tesla internal costs.
limitation.zh: 具体价格、排除项、保证及补救须看执行合同；通用模型不代表Tesla内部成本。

title.en: Four posts are a real product option
title.zh: 四枪是实际产品选项

claim.en: The current product page permits a minimum four-post purchase and asks the owner to hire an installer.
claim.zh: 当前产品页允许最低购买4枪，并要求业主自行聘请安装方。

limitation.en: A four-post project needs its own electrical/civil scope. Public equipment pricing does not guarantee proportional utility or land costs.
limitation.zh: 四枪项目须独立电气/土建设计，公开设备定价不保证接电及土地成本按比例下降。

title.en: A vendor estimate is not an approved project
title.zh: 厂家估算不是获批项目

claim.en: At the Edmonds research address, the estimator showed 8 posts: $500,000 hardware plus $55,000 installation/post, $940,000 total and indicative 5-year payback. Selecting 4 posts showed $250,000 hardware and $470,000 total.
claim.zh: 对Edmonds研究地址，配置器显示8枪设备50万美元、每枪安装5.5万美元、合计94万美元，示例回本5年；实际切换4枪显示设备25万美元、合计47万美元。

limitation.en: Nonbinding estimate, not a scoped quote, site approval or our underwriting result. Hardware tax is excluded; installation tier was the default Medium.
limitation.zh: 均为非约束估算，不是完整报价、场地批准或本项目门槛结论；不含设备税，安装档位为默认Medium。

title.en: Why Tesla’s five-year illustration differs
title.zh: Tesla五年示例为何不同

claim.en: Edmonds defaults were $0.10/kWh utility cost, $0.49 selling price and 298 kWh/post/day. The disclaimer assumes 7% annual utilization growth, about 15% grid-to-battery loss and no parking rent.
claim.zh: Edmonds默认购电0.10美元/度、售价0.49美元/度、每枪每天298度；免责声明假设利用率年增7%、电网到电池约15%损耗，并且没有停车位租金。

limitation.en: Utility tooltip includes demand charges and uses fleet-utilization context; it is not a local tariff quote.15-year vendor revenue/payback cannot be directly compared with our flat-real-demand 10-year NPV. Energy boundary requires reconciliation.
limitation.zh: 购电提示说明含需量费并参考车队利用率，不是本址费率报价；厂家15年收入/回本不可直接与固定实际需求的10年NPV比较，电量边界仍须统一。

title.en: Do not pay twice for included service
title.zh: 已包含服务不能重复计费

claim.en: The fee modal includes a 10+year equipment parts/labor service agreement,97% uptime guarantee, card processing, internet and network services within the stated $0.10/kWh package.
claim.zh: 0.10美元/度服务费弹窗列明10年以上设备零件/人工服务协议、97%可用率保证、刷卡处理、网络连接及运营服务。

limitation.en: Avoid duplicating included costs. Our extra full-capex-based replacement allowance has no itemized uncovered-asset basis; this is an unresolved scope risk, not proof every reserve dollar is double counted.
limitation.zh: 应避免重复计入已覆盖费用。当前按总资本比例计提额外更换预留缺少未覆盖资产明细，属于范围待核，不能据此断定全部重复计费。

title.en: Operating contribution differs from net profit
title.zh: 经营贡献不等于净利润

claim.en: EVgo Q2 2026 reports $61.421 m charging-network revenue and $39.247 m network cost of sales; depreciation is separate. Consolidated net loss was $46.342 m.
claim.zh: EVgo2026年第二季度充电网络收入6142.1万美元、网络销售成本3924.7万美元，折旧另列；合并净亏损4634.2万美元。

limitation.en: The $22.174 m difference is before separate depreciation/corporate costs, not net profit or candidate economics. Positive operating contribution and company losses can coexist.
limitation.zh: 两者差额2217.4万美元尚未扣单列折旧及公司费用，不是净利润或候选址经济性；经营贡献为正可与公司亏损并存。

title.en: Commercial cofunding exists
title.zh: 存在商业共同出资

claim.en: EVgo reported $6.522 m Q2 capital offsets: $1.352 m OEM infrastructure payments and $5.170 m capital-build funding, against $33.823 m gross capital expenditure. Public-network throughput was 276 kWh/stall/day.
claim.zh: EVgo披露第二季度资本抵补652.2万美元，其中车企基础设施付款135.2万美元、建设资金517万美元，对应总资本支出3382.3万美元；公共网络每枪每天276度。

limitation.en: Commercial cofunding is a real additional mechanism, not an available award for these sites. The 276 benchmark covers EVgo-owned public stalls, not all 5,380 ending stalls or Tesla utilization.
limitation.zh: 商业共同出资是实际存在的额外机制，不是这些场地已可取得的资助；276度对应EVgo自营公共枪位，不是全部5380个期末枪位或Tesla利用率。

title.en: Tesla’s mixed segment cannot prove station returns
title.zh: Tesla混合业务不能证明单站收益

claim.en: Tesla Q3 2026 services-and-other revenue was $4.605 bn against $3.871 bn costs. The filing associates growth with used vehicles, repairs and paid Supercharging.
claim.zh: Tesla2026年第三季度服务及其他收入46.05亿美元、成本38.71亿美元；文件将增长关联至二手车、维修和付费超充。

limitation.en: This mixed category does not disclose standalone Supercharging profit, each site’s returns or Tesla’s internal cost of capital.
limitation.zh: 该混合类别未披露独立超充利润、逐站回报或Tesla内部资本成本。

title.en: Credit rights follow the contract
title.zh: 积分权益取决于合同

claim.en: Los Gatos’s attached historical agreement allocates construction, utility and charger-maintenance costs to Tesla; the host cannot collect charging fees. Its proposed 2021 amendment assigns incentives to Tesla and specifies rent.
claim.zh: Los Gatos所附历史协议由Tesla承担施工、电费及设备维护，地主不能收充电费；2021年拟议修订将激励权益归Tesla并约定租金。

limitation.en: A dated contract example, not current standard terms: the amendment is unsigned in the packet and does not prove execution or current payment. Credit ownership must be checked before booking incentives.
limitation.zh: 这是有日期的合同示例，非当前标准条款；附件修订未签字，不证明已执行或当前实付。计入补贴前须核实权益归属。

sensitivityExplanation.en: Separate conditional sensitivities preserve the original gross costs and hard gates. Support is never booked as an actual award. Zero/30%/80% gross-capex cases are mathematical ceilings, not eligible-cost determinations. Payback is lasting cumulative recovery within the modeled horizon: temporary recovery followed by later losses does not count. Temporary Machias support expires and is capped; no other aid is stacked. The Machias illustration retains the old eight-post Tesla/state-electricity proxy; it is not a costed grant-compliant design. No observed site return has changed.
sensitivityExplanation.zh: 独立条件敏感性保留原始总成本及硬门槛，绝不把支持当作实际授奖。0/30%/80%总投资比例仅为数学上限，不是合格成本认定。回本指模型期内此后不再转负的累计回收，临时回收后又亏回去不算。Machias临时支持受期限与总额限制，不叠加其他支持。 Machias示例沿用旧八枪Tesla及州电价代理值，并非已报价的补贴合规设计，真实站点回报没有据此得到验证。
